visual_findings: Atrium reference has a rooted branching hierarchy, layered ground planting, low inhabited edges and abundant floor routes; its monumental central tree is not the target scale.
Intimate and dense residential references use visible mid-height trunks, restrained planter foliage, usable seating and clear outlook openings.
Review will judge the six assets as component baseline only; no game acceptance or complete-room fit.
